title: PocketRPG
intro: Welcome! PocketRPG is a tool to help you run ad-hoc RPG games when you're on the run. Everything works offline.

track.title: Track
track.body: Run a game. Set up a story and characters, then roll checks, keep XP and resources, and look back at what happened.

tools.title: Tools
tools.body: A bag of gamemaster tools: dice, name generators, and other inspiration.
